items.prompt: Manu faces the rising Sun. Which direction is he facing?
items.method: The Sun rises in the east.

items.prompt: Facing North, which direction is on the left?
Facing East, turn right. Which direction?
items.method: Clockwise quarter turn from East points South.

items.prompt: If a point is 3 steps east and 2 steps north of the start, describe its route.
items.method: Record each direction and number of steps.

items.prompt: Why is a map key useful?
items.answer: It explains the symbols used on the map.
items.method: Read the legend before interpreting symbols.

items.prompt: Why can two routes between stations both be valid?
items.answer: A map may offer different sequences of roads/lines connecting the same places.
items.method: Trace each route and compare its steps/stations.
